description: Election Commission - Mr. H. A. N. E. Perera of the Puttalam Pradeshiya Sabha has Vacated his Office of member of that Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice declares that a member of the Puttalam Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated their office due to ceasing membership in their political party. This is an electoral matter specifically related to the membership status of a local government elected official, falling under the Elections category (Type 7) as it deals with the electoral process and status of elected representatives in local authorities.
